title: CBI and a drug case
script:
Caller: Namaste madam, main CBI Delhi se Inspector Rathore bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar se ek bank account khula hai.
Dadi: Kaisa account? Maine toh kuch nahi kiya.
Caller: Us account mein do crore ki money laundering hui hai. Aapke naam ka arrest warrant nikal chuka hai.
Dadi: Hai Ram, ab kya hoga?
Caller: Aap video call pe aaiye. Phone mat kaatna, aur ghar mein kisi ko mat batana.

title: Court on video, then a "safe" account
script:
Caller: Madam, aap ab digital arrest mein hain. Abhi Supreme Court ke judge aapse baat karenge.
Dadi: Judge sahab? Mujhse?
Caller: Aapke saare paise RBI ki jaanch mein jayenge. Jaanch ke baad vapas mil jayenge.
Dadi: Toh mujhe kya karna hai?
Caller: FD tod kar saara paisa is safe account mein transfer kar dijiye, aaj hi.

title: FedEx parcel to Taiwan
script:
Caller: Hello, FedEx Mumbai se bol rahe hain. Aapke naam ka parcel Taiwan ja raha tha, customs ne pakda hai.
Dadi: Maine koi parcel nahi bheja.
Caller: Usme paanch passport aur drugs mile hain. Main call Mumbai crime branch ko transfer kar raha hoon.
Dadi: Arre, ye kya ho gaya?
Caller: Officer aapse baat karenge. Tab tak kisi se baat mat kijiye.

title: KYC expired
script:
Caller: Madam, SBI se bol raha hoon. Aapka KYC expire ho gaya hai, aaj raat account band ho jayega.
Dadi: Toh main branch aa jaati hoon kal.
Caller: Nahi nahi, branch mat jaiye, line bahut lambi hai. Main yahin se kar deta hoon.
Dadi: Achha.
Caller: Abhi ek OTP aayega, bas woh bata dijiye.

title: Son arrested
script:
Caller: Aap Rohit ki mummy bol rahi hain? Main thane se bol raha hoon. Aapke bete ne accident kar diya hai.
Dadi: Kya? Rohit theek toh hai?
Caller: Abhi hamare paas hai. Case banne se pehle pachaas hazaar de dijiye, chhod denge.
Dadi: Main uske papa se baat kar leti hoon.
Caller: Nahi, kisi ko batayengi toh FIR ho jayegi. Is number pe Google Pay kar dijiye.

title: KBC lottery
script:
Caller: Badhai ho madam! Aapka number KBC lucky draw mein aaya hai. Aapne pachees lakh jeete hain.
Dadi: Sach mein? Maine toh khela hi nahi.
Caller: Sim card se automatic selection hota hai. Bas GST aur processing fee ke 12,500 pehle jama karne honge.

title: Electricity cut tonight
script:
Caller: Bijli vibhag se bol raha hoon. Aapka pichhla bill update nahi hua, aaj raat nau baje connection kat jayega.
Dadi: Bill toh maine bhar diya tha.
Caller: System mein nahi dikh raha. Main ek link bhej raha hoon, das rupaye pay karke update kar lijiye.

title: AnyDesk to fix a refund
script:
Caller: Amazon customer care se bol raha hoon. Aapka 2,400 ka refund atka hua hai.
Dadi: Haan, wapas karna tha ek saaman.
Caller: Play Store se AnyDesk download kijiye, main aapke phone pe khud kar dunga.

title: Wrong money sent to you
script:
Caller: Aunty ji, galti se aapke number pe 5,000 chale gaye. Mere bete ki fees thi.
Dadi: Achha? Mujhe toh pata nahi.
Caller: Message aaya hoga. Please wapas bhej dijiye, bahut zaroori hai.

title: Pay to receive a refund
script:
Caller: Madam, aapka 1,200 ka refund process karna hai. Aapke PhonePe pe ek request aayi hogi.
Dadi: Haan, kuch aaya hai. Par isme toh pay likha hai.
Caller: Woh normal process hai. Approve karke PIN daal dijiye, paise aa jayenge.

title: YouTube likes job
script:
Caller: Hello, part-time kaam hai ghar baithe. YouTube video like karo, roz teen hazaar kamao.
Dadi: Itna aasan hai?
Caller: Haan, pehle Telegram group join kijiye. VIP task ke liye 2,000 deposit karna hoga, double hokar wapas milega.

title: Guaranteed share tips
script:
Caller: Sir, hum market experts hain. Hamare WhatsApp group mein log roz das percent kama rahe hain.
Dadi: Risk nahi hai?
Caller: Bilkul zero risk, guaranteed return. Aaj 50,000 lagaiye, ek hafte mein double.

title: Instant loan fee
script:
Caller: Aapka paanch lakh ka loan pre-approved hai, koi CIBIL nahi chahiye.
Dadi: Maine apply nahi kiya.
Caller: Bank ne khud select kiya hai. Bas 2,999 file charge bhej dijiye, loan aaj hi aa jayega.

title: PM Kisan money
script:
Caller: Namaste, Krishi mantralaya se. Aapke PM Kisan ke 18,000 atke hue hain.
Dadi: Achha, kaise milenge?
Caller: Aadhaar number bataiye. Phir mobile pe code aayega, woh bhi bata dijiyega.

title: Flood relief
script:
Caller: Namaste, hum baadh peediton ke liye relief fund jama kar rahe hain.
Dadi: Kaunsi sanstha hai aapki?
Caller: Details baad mein bhej denge. Abhi bachche bhookhe hain, is QR ko scan karke jo ho sake dijiye.

title: English: tax refund
script:
Caller: Good morning, this is the Income Tax Department. You have a refund of 46,000 rupees pending.
Dadi: Oh, I did not know that.
Caller: To release it, please click the link we sent and enter your card details and PIN.

edge_case: Never says OTP, bank or police
title: No scary words at all
script:
Caller: Aunty ji, aapke phone pe abhi ek message aaya hoga, chhe number wala.
Dadi: Haan, kuch aaya hai.
Caller: Bas woh number padh dijiye, aapka kaam ho jayega.

title: Dadi reads out the code
script:
Caller: Madam, bank se bol raha hoon. Jo code aaya hai woh bata dijiye.
Dadi: Ruko, chashma lagati hoon. Haan, chaar, saat, do, nau.
Caller: Aur uske baad?
Dadi: Ek, paanch.

title: "Never share your OTP, but tell me"
script:
Caller: Madam, fraud department se. Kabhi kisi ke saath OTP share mat kijiye, bahut fraud ho rahe hain.
Dadi: Haan beta, sahi kaha.
Caller: Isiliye aapka account safe karna hai. Ye mera official number hai, mujhe bata dijiye, kisi aur ko nahi.

edge_case: Start after a warning has played, or say it anyway
title: Caller attacks the warning
script:
Caller: Main cyber crime se bol raha hoon, aapke naam pe case hai.
Dadi: Ye phone mein koi bol raha hai ki fraud hai.
Caller: Woh machine hai madam, usko band kar dijiye. Main fraud nahi hoon, main sarkari officer hoon.
Dadi: Pakka?
Caller: Pakka. Jurmana bhar dijiye, warna kal police ghar aayegi.

title: Slow build over small talk
script:
Caller: Namaste amma ji, kaisi hain? Tabiyat theek hai?
Dadi: Haan beta, theek hoon. Aap kaun?
Caller: Main aapki pension wale daftar se. Mera naam Suresh hai. Aapke yahan baarish hui kya?
Dadi: Haan, kal hui thi.
Caller: Achha achha. Khana khaya aapne? Bachche kaise hain?
Dadi: Sab theek hain.
Caller: Bas ek chhota sa kaam hai. Pension chalu rakhni hai toh jeevan pramaan karna hoga. Phone pe ek number aayega, woh bol dijiyega.

title: Voice of a grandchild
script:
Caller: Dadi, main bol raha hoon. Pehchana?
Dadi: Kaun, Aman?
Caller: Haan Aman. Dadi, mera phone toot gaya, ye dost ka number hai. Fees bharni hai aaj, papa ko mat batana, daantenge.
Dadi: Kitne chahiye?
Caller: Bees hazaar, is number pe bhej do. Kal wapas kar dunga.

edge_case: The caller offers to pay you
title: Army officer renting a flat
script:
Caller: Main Major Vikram bol raha hoon, aapka flat kiraye pe lena hai. Advance abhi bhej deta hoon.
Dadi: Achha, theek hai.
Caller: Army ka system alag hai. Main QR bhej raha hoon, scan karke amount daaliye, paise aapko aa jayenge.

edge_case: An install with no app name
title: Traffic challan app
script:
Caller: Traffic police, aapki gaadi ka challan pending hai. WhatsApp pe file bheji hai.
Dadi: Kaisi file?
Caller: Usko khol kar install kar lijiye aur jo permission maange de dijiye. Challan wahin dikhega.

title: Screen on video call
script:
Caller: Madam, aapke phone mein virus aa gaya hai, company se bol raha hoon.
Dadi: Arre, ab kya karun?
Caller: Video call pe aaiye aur apna phone ka display mujhe dikhaiye, main theek karwa deta hoon.

edge_case: Password and customer ID, no OTP
title: Bank app password
script:
Caller: Aapki net banking lock ho gayi hai. Main unlock kar deta hoon.
Dadi: Kaise?
Caller: Apna customer ID aur password bata dijiye, do minute ka kaam hai.

title: Gift cards for the boss
script:
Caller: Hi, this is your director. I am in a meeting and need a favour, keep it between us.
Dadi: Yes sir, what do you need?
Caller: Buy five Amazon gift cards of 10,000 each and read me the codes.

edge_case: SMS to a number, then read back
title: SIM upgrade
script:
Caller: Airtel se bol raha hoon. Aapka SIM do ghante mein band ho jayega, 5G upgrade baaki hai.
Dadi: Kya karna hoga?
Caller: Ek message 121 pe bhej dijiye, phir jo number aaye woh mujhe bata dijiye.

edge_case: The victim says the right things
title: Dadi refuses firmly
script:
Caller: SBI se, aapka card block ho raha hai. OTP bataiye.
Dadi: Nahi, main OTP nahi dungi. Main branch jaungi.
Caller: Madam, aaj hi block ho jayega.
Dadi: Hone do. Main phone rakh rahi hoon.

edge_case: The victim offers before being asked twice
title: Dadi agrees to pay
script:
Caller: Customs se bol raha hoon, aapke parcel pe 8,000 ka tax baaki hai, warna case hoga.
Dadi: Theek hai beta, main abhi Paytm se bhej deti hoon. Case mat karna.

edge_case: Stand near traffic or a TV, and mumble
title: Noisy line, broken speech
script:
Caller: Hello... haan... police se... aapke naam pe... warrant... sunai de raha hai?
Dadi: Kya? Awaaz nahi aa rahi.
Caller: Warrant hai... paise bhejo... abhi ke abhi... warna arrest.

title: Mixed Hindi and English, fast
script:
Caller: Sir, I am calling from Alpha Traders. Hamara bot daily returns deta hai, USDT mein invest karo.
Dadi: Ye kya hota hai?
Caller: Crypto hai sir, totally safe. Wallet address WhatsApp karta hoon, 500 dollars send kar dijiye, 48 hours mein double.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Real bank fraud alert
script:
Caller: Madam, HDFC fraud team se. Kal raat 45,000 ka transaction hua, kya aapne kiya tha?
Dadi: Nahi, maine nahi kiya.
Caller: Theek hai, card block kar diya hai. Hum OTP ya PIN kabhi nahi maangte. Branch se naya card le lijiye.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Delivery OTP at the door
script:
Caller: Madam, Amazon delivery, main gate pe khada hoon. Aapka parcel hai.
Dadi: Achha, aati hoon.
Caller: Delivery OTP bata dijiye, tabhi order close hoga.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Grandchild really needs money
script:
Caller: Dadi, Aman bol raha hoon. Hostel ki fees ke 5,000 kam pad rahe hain.
Dadi: Tere papa se baat hui?
Caller: Haan, unhone kaha aapse le loon. Sunday ko ghar aaunga, wapas de dunga.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Grandchild warns about a scam
script:
Caller: Dadi, sun lo. Aajkal log CBI ban kar phone karte hain aur bolte hain digital arrest hai.
Dadi: Haan, TV pe dekha tha.
Caller: Woh OTP maangte hain, paise transfer karwate hain. Koi aisa bole toh phone kaat dena, mujhe call karna.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Dadi tells a friend what happened
script:
Caller: Sharma ji ke saath kya hua pata hai? Kisi ne police ban ke arrest warrant ki dhamki di.
Dadi: Hai Ram! Phir?
Caller: Unhone do lakh safe account mein bhej diye. Bechare. Aap kabhi mat bhejna.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Real police verification
script:
Caller: Namaste, local thane se constable Yadav. Aapke kirayedar ki verification karni hai.
Dadi: Ji, batayiye.
Caller: Kal subah thane aa jaiye, rent agreement aur Aadhaar ki copy le aana.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Hospital asks for an advance
script:
Caller: Apollo Hospital reception se. Aapke pati ka operation kal hai.
Dadi: Ji, pata hai.
Caller: Admission ke time 25,000 advance counter pe jama karna hoga. Card ya cash, jo aapko theek lage.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: EMI reminder
script:
Caller: Axis Bank ki taraf se reminder. Aapki 12,450 ki EMI paanch tareekh ko due hai.
Dadi: Haan, account mein paise hain.
Caller: Ji, auto debit ho jayega. Aap bank app se bhi dekh sakti hain. Dhanyavaad.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Pushy insurance agent
script:
Caller: Madam, LIC agent Verma bol raha hoon. Ye plan sirf is mahine hai, guaranteed bonus milta hai.
Dadi: Abhi nahi chahiye.
Caller: Soch lijiye, main ghar aa jaata hoon, papers dikha dunga. Koi jaldi nahi hai.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Kirana bill on UPI
script:
Caller: Aunty, Gupta store se. Aapka 1,850 ka bill ho gaya, saaman bhej diya hai.
Dadi: Achha, kaise doon?
Caller: Shop pe QR laga hai, ya ladke ko cash de dena. Jab theek lage.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Real KYC notice
script:
Caller: Madam, Canara Bank branch se. Aapka KYC is mahine renew karna hai.
Dadi: Phone pe ho jayega?
Caller: Nahi madam, phone pe nahi. Aadhaar aur PAN ki copy leke branch aa jaiye. Koi jaldi nahi.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Son discussing money
script:
Caller: Maa, maine aapke account mein 20,000 transfer kiye hain, dawai ke liye.
Dadi: Achha beta, message aaya tha.
Caller: Aur haan, bank wala koi OTP maange toh mat dena.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Electricity outage notice
script:
Caller: Bijli vibhag ki soochna. Kal subah das se do baje tak aapke area mein bijli band rahegi.
Dadi: Kyun?
Caller: Line ka kaam chal raha hai. Bas yahi batana tha.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Job interview
script:
Caller: Hello, TCS HR se Priya bol rahi hoon. Aapke pote ka resume shortlist hua hai.
Dadi: Achha, uska number deti hoon.
Caller: Ji. Interview guruwar ko office mein hai, koi fees nahi hai.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Doctor asks for details
script:
Caller: Dr Mehta ke clinic se. Aapki report aa gayi hai.
Dadi: Sab theek hai?
Caller: Pehle confirm kar loon, aapki date of birth kya hai? Doctor saab aapko kal bulaya hai.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Cashback the customer expected
script:
Caller: Beta bol raha hoon. Maa, Flipkart ka refund aa gaya kya?
Dadi: Haan, 1,200 aaye hain.
Caller: Achha, cashback bhi aayega. Kuch karna nahi hai, apne aap aa jayega.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Wrong number
script:
Caller: Hello, Rajesh ji? Parcel pahuncha?
Dadi: Yahan koi Rajesh nahi hai.
Caller: Oh, sorry, galat number lag gaya. Maaf kijiye.

group: Normal call that sounds like a scam
title: Everyday family chat, with numbers
script:
Caller: Dadi, mera naya phone number likh lo. Nau, aath, ek, do, teen, chaar, paanch, chhah, saat, aath.
Dadi: Ruko, phir bolo.
Caller: Aur ghar ka gate code 4512 hai, Sunday ko aa rahe hain.
